LeaderboardScore.title: LeaderboardScore
LeaderboardScore.description: Public top score record for a player in Petualangan Mario (no PII stored).

playerId.description: Unique browser/player identifier owning this leaderboard entry.

playerName.description: Display nickname shown on the public leaderboard.

score.description: Highest score achieved by the player.

bossDefeated.description: Whether the player has defeated the Final Boss.

quizCorrect.description: Total correct quiz answers in the best run.

quizTotal.description: Total quiz attempts in the best run.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Public leaderboard entries keyed by playerId.
